entries.subject: 3D previews of the realms in the map picker and beside each public game
A public game nobody joins is swapped for a different realm, so the list turns over every half minute
New map: The Crown Isles, nine large islands in a ring around a greater one
Three public games are open at once, on different realms, starting half a minute apart
Two original maps: The Sundered Sea and Ironspine
A pact shows as linked rings above your ally's label, fading as it runs out and pulsing when it can be renewed
A dropped connection mid-game now reconnects by itself and carries on from the turn it missed
Fix the freeze while placing buildings; the server install now really replaces the maps; a realm taken from the server is drawn as the server has it
Maps rebuilt so sea routes never cross land: no water thinner than four tiles, no hidden ponds
Ships and their wakes are kept off the land: every drawn position is stood off the shore by the ship's beam
The land is flat: hills and mountains are painted on, so nothing sails or marches through a hillside
Map labels, the realm list and tooltips show each house's own designed arms
Store: confirm before spending Crowns; no paying for a house name or bundle you already own
Aiming a fireball or dragon shows its flight and whether a ballista tower covers it; sea trail cards in the store are live 3D
Sea trails are translucent and soft-edged so they sit in the water
Arms editor: choose the colour of your charge
Store: snail knights, geese, swan boats, tower turtles, toadstool towns and more new 3D sets; all 2D items are now medieval heraldry
Longships trace their route with a dotted line; 54 sea trails in the store
Narrow straits show as water, war galleys get health bars, longships leave a wake, sorcery shows its flight line
Signed-in players keep their reserved house name even if the page connected before sign-in
Multiplayer games give 30 seconds to choose a starting spot
Territory runs to the waterline and borders are rounded instead of stepped
No splash when trade ships arrive at a harbour
Building level numbers go past 40 (up to 256)
Store: new troop, ship and building models, 57 territory cloths, bigger arms editor, shop with live 3D previews
Store: Crown packs, cosmetics for territory, banner, ships, buildings and troops, bundles, reserved house names
Answer button is a sword
Troop counts on the front lines, war list above the player strip, Answer button on incoming attacks
Build bar shows how many of each you have; standings move to the top left
HUD: player strip beside the attack slider, chronicle on the right, blast rings, merged rings
Colour every land tile; kingdom and clan counts match upstream
Never draw the waiting room over a running game; browsers must revalidate map files
Fix second game never starting; server log shows each client's start steps
Fix multiplayer desync: keep turns that arrive while the map downloads; bridge narrow rivers and gaps; flatter mountains
Public games: countdown on the server's clock, failed starts reported instead of hanging
Smaller war galleys, much smaller merchant cogs
Remove install transcript from the repo
Changelog and build version generated from git on every deploy
Server dashboard: live view and controls at /admin
Fix Windows service install args
Tell the player when the game server is out of date
Flatter mountains so buildings sit on slopes, not cliffs
Real-world realms (Earth, Europe, Mediterranean, Greece), range rings and building levels
Install script: substitute the right placeholder
Server: default hostname play.crusades.io
renamed to crusades.io
added source URL
